Quantum 1.17.1 was certified on 2026-08-25. It pins **nucleus v1.12.1**, **quark v1.6.1** and **orbit v1.7.3**, with 5 sibling modules.

A patch release of the suite after Quantum 1.17.0: nucleus goes from v1.12.0 to v1.12.1 (patch), quark goes from v1.6.0 to v1.6.1 (patch) and orbit goes from v1.7.0 to v1.7.3 (patch). 4 sibling modules change version.
